name: section-explorer
description: Shared blueprint-agnostic two-pane section/page navigator. customJS.SectionExplorer.render(dv, adapter) draws a rail-of-sections + page-pane explorer with inline section rename/delete/add-link, parameterized by a per-blueprint adapter built via SectionExplorer.makeAdapter(config) (mirrors ChromeBar.makeAdapter). Reuses BeaconCards for the page grid, MenuPopover for the rail-row ⋯ menu, SectionLabel, and DocSearch untouched.
